# Stage 00-idea: Idea

[all stages](./README.md) · [01-validate →](./01-validate.md)

**Purpose.** Turn a vague idea into a one-page statement of who it is for, what problem it solves and how it earns money.

**Exit gate.** You can state customer, problem, offer and revenue model in four sentences, and name the three riskiest assumptions.
